links.outcome: Recommended reading age and reading difficulty of LLM glaucoma education answers
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.0 had higher recommended reading age and reading difficulty scores than the other models; the abstract gives no numbers. Baichuan 2 and ChatGPT-4.0 were rated best overall.
links.quote: In the first stage, Baichuan 2 and ChatGPT-4.0 outperformed the other two models, though ChatGPT-4.0 had higher recommended reading age and reading difficulty scores.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating four LLMs for glaucoma patient education with real patients and clinicians scoring outputs in a clinical setting; evaluates model performance across dimensions including readability and safety without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
